## Abstract

This GeoEpi project brings together work on foot-and-mouth disease spread dynamics, transmission, and simulated response analyses. Registered work includes preclinical spread, control-zone design in Sri Lanka, and endemic foot-and-mouth disease analyses for Vietnam.
